title: Qt: WelcomePage: preserve user capture filter and avoid clearing on interface conflict
description:
This MR fixes an issue where the capture filter field on the Welcome Page was being unintentionally cleared when a selected interface had a conflict.

Previously, if CaptureFilterEdit::getSelectedFilter() returned a conflict, the user-entered filter was erased, even if the user intended to keep it.

Changes made:
- Updated WelcomePage::interfaceSelected() to preserve the capture filter text in case of conflict.
- Still indicate the conflict state with setConflict(true) so that the user is aware.

Benefits:
- Prevents accidental loss of user input.
- Improves UX by maintaining the filter until the user explicitly changes it.

Testing:
- Selected multiple interfaces with and without conflicts.
- Verified that the filter remains in conflict cases and behaves normally otherwise.

Fixes: #<issue_number>

qt: WelcomePage: preserve captura filter on interface conflict

Previously, the capture filter field was cleared when an interface
conflict ocurred. This change keep the user-entered filter text intact,
improving usability when reselecting interfaces.
